description: For sets A and B, eventual equality along the cofinite filter holds if and only if their symmetric difference, the union of A minus B and B minus A, is finite.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.almostEq_iff_finite_symmDiff.{u} {α : Type u} (A B : Set α) :
  A =ᶠ[Filter.cofinite] B ↔ (A \ B ∪ B \ A).Finite
